Role code RW-DATASTEW is in neither the item nor the story, and the note says URP v5 does not list it.
The DL25 sentence adds a date (26 November 2026) to the story text.

Background says P1 reads v_ace_account and v_ace_payment directly, which contradicts the data-product contract rule (CG-ALL-1033).
